cohort: The study included 882 undocumented pregnant migrant women and 3528 matched controls, comprising both documented migrant and non-migrant women.
finding: Undocumented pregnant migrant women had higher adjusted odds of experiencing stillbirth (aOR 3.50; 95% CI 1.31-9.38) and preterm birth (aOR 1.41; 95% CI 1.04-1.93) compared with the control group.
